scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply moly --local && wrangler dev
scripts.db:feedback: wrangler d1 execute moly --local --command "SELECT received_at, emailed, app_version, device, sender_id, contact, substr(message, 1, 80) AS message FROM feedback ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 25"
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
